description_en: Imports task phone numbers in batches for the industry edition
description_zh: 行业版-批量导入任务号码
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs import-number --out-id '示例值示例值' --task-id 92 --customers '[{"Number":"13541251222","ClientUrl":"http://test.com","Tag":"tag1","NumberMD5":"示例值","Properties":{"testt":"123"}}]' --fail-return 0 --api-version 2023-05-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportNumber

parameters.help_en: The task ID. Must be determined in advance
parameters.name: task_id

element_fields.help_en: The plaintext phone number. Either NumberMD5 or Number must be specified
element_fields.help_zh: 手机明文号码，md5和number两者必传其中一个
element_fields.name: number

element_fields.help_en: The customer pop-up URL. This is a special field
element_fields.name: client_url

element_fields.help_en: The MD5 hash of the phone number. Either NumberMD5 or Number must be specified
element_fields.help_zh: 电话号码MD5，md5和number两者必传其中一个
element_fields.name: number_md5

element_fields.help_en: The properties that must be specified based on the specific task parameter requirements. The total length is limited to 500 characters. Excess characters are truncated
element_fields.help_zh: 需根据具体任务参数要求传输（总长度500个字符，多余的会被剔除）
element_fields.name: properties

parameters.help_en: The outbound call customers, including specific user information such as phone numbers and names. A maximum of 1000 customers can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 外呼客户，具体用户信息，如手机号、姓名等。限制数量最多1000个
parameters.name: customers

parameters.help_en:
Valid values:
- 0: imports the data that passes validation and returns the data that fails validation.
- 1: does not import any data (including data that passes and fails validation).

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 可选值：0，1，默认1。如导入的数据中有部分验证不通过数据：0表示导入验证成功的，返回失败的数据；1表示全部数据（包括验证成功及失败的）都不导入；
parameters.name: fail_return
